nights.title: Sami Beigi Live in Toronto
nights.name: Sami Beigi
nights.extract: Saman Es'hagh Beigi, known as Sami Beigi, is an Iranian singer and songwriter currently living in Irvine, California, United States.

nights.title: DJ Tennis | 4AM License
nights.name: DJ Tennis
nights.extract: Manfredi Romano, known professionally as DJ Tennis, is an Italian electronic dance music DJ, music producer and label owner.

nights.title: Tobiahs
nights.name: Tobiahs
nights.extract: Tobiahs Fakhri, known professionally by the mononym Tobiahs, is an Australian electronic dance music producer, singer, songwriter, and musician from Melbourne, Australia. He is best known for his singles "Lifetime" and "Angel of Mine".
